code='''def transform(grid):
    # Identify the uniform background color, then mark the first gap after
    # any left-aligned horizontal band that stops before the right edge.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for row in out:
        if not row or row[0] == bg:
            continue
        color = row[0]
        end = 0
        while end < len(row) and row[end] == color:
            end += 1
        if end < len(row) and all(v == bg for v in row[end:]):
            row[end] = 1
    return out
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        last = max((j for j, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg), default=-1)
        if last < 0 or last == len(row) - 1:
            continue
        prefix = row[:last + 1]
        for k, ref in enumerate(grid):
            if k == i or ref[:last + 1] != prefix:
                continue
            if any(v != bg for v in ref[last + 1:]):
                for j in range(last + 1, len(row)):
                    if row[j] == bg and ref[j] != bg:
                        out[i][j] = 1
        
    return out
'''
